featured_reviews.review_text:
I bought a chess board set from this shop on 29-01-2026 as a gift for my friend. When he opened it, we found that one white pawn was missing from the box.
I went back to the shop with a valid bill expecting basic responsibility and customer support. Instead, the owner refused to help and completely denied any compliance. There was no attempt to verify the issue, no apology, and no effort to provide a replacement.
This shows a total lack of professionalism and zero customer-centered service. Selling a product is easy, but standing by it is what defines a genuine business. Unfortunately, this shop clearly does not believe in after-sales support.
Very disappointing experience. I would strongly advise customers to thoroughly check items before leaving the store because once you walk out, they take no responsibility.
Not recommended at all.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I was in Mumbai last week and visited Galaxy Sports Shop in Metro, Dhabi Talao, to buy two cricket bats—one for myself and a harrow-size bat for my 13-year-old son. The shop owner, Harshad, was extremely helpful and very knowledgeable. With the rising prices of English willow bats, he guided us to the best options that were excellent in quality and still within our budget.

He was kind enough to machine-knock both bats for us at no extra cost, which was really appreciated. The shop is fully stocked with a wide range of sports equipment and accessories—cricket, football, tennis, badminton, paddle sports, and more.

I would highly recommend Galaxy Sports Shop for all your sporting needs in Mumbai.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for genuine and top-quality cricket gear!

featured_reviews.name: H P
featured_reviews.review_text: They have a good variety and range of all types of sporting equipment and accessories. Perfect for anyone and everyone. Plus they also can provide you with customized jerseys at very good prices. The quality however is not so good for the jerseys and tracks. Further since this seems to be a business started maybe a decade ago or more, they are yet to modernize things. There is not much information available online and they do not provide much details over the phone, you have to physically visit the store. I can understand their concerns however if they do modernize I am sure they will generate more interest and business from various parts of the city rather than being limited to just south mumbai. Staff is friendly and courteous, this is a big pro.
